findings.classification: Existing historical canonical q460; 95e source corroboration; related q637; not a newly counted independent finding.

source_trace.finding: Public shell admits surface UV with direct texcoords None when original UV extent is valid; a subset of faces may use only some original vertices.
Exporter validates then compacts every shell.
Compaction remaps positions, normals, skin, morphs and explicit texcoords, but retains original surface UV channel.
Writer selects direct texcoords or surface UV fallback, and emits its unremapped length.

findings.trigger_and_consequence: Conditional on surface Some, direct texcoords None and used-vertex selection changing source vertex count/order: UV accessor no longer corresponds to the compacted position population. This is a source contract inference, not observed GLB/parser output.
findings.producer_qualification: Canonical armor producer character_morphs.rs 243–255 supplies direct Some(&armor.texcoords), and equipment_export.rs 82–90 may add surface; direct coordinates are remapped and win. Thus that inspected producer does not prove a surface-only witness. Clothing 216–237 has no surface/UV; garment/export.rs 13–18 and character_export/hair.rs 81–87 have no surface. Other public callers remain unassessed.
findings.future_repair_direction: Coordinate one effective UV channel with the exact vertex selection/remap and preserve supported optional surface/material modes; central owns remediation grouping.
findings.historical_relationship: 059 queue entries 460 and 637 and original receipts; e275 READ-L11-622 explicitly aliases same first failure to q460. Preserve authors/revisions.

findings.classification: Existing 774 source-backed candidate; bounded 95e source corroboration; do not add a duplicate count.

source_trace.finding: Public UV socket helper admits raw borrowed mesh/shell, checks UV domain and face count, then indexes mesh skin, shell normals/positions; bootstrap has analogous position index.
Garment caller computes sockets before invoking export_rigged_glb; the later serialization validation cannot by itself protect the earlier helper.
Public borrowed arrays may be independently supplied.

findings.trigger_and_consequence: Conditioned on a structurally malformed public mesh/shell/skin and an eligible selected UV face, indexing can fail before the Result returns a structured error. 774 provides a source-reasoned malformed input, not a produced asset or executed witness. The regular garment producer structural guarantees were not established.
findings.future_repair_direction: Admit a coherent mesh/shell/UV/skin view or reject mismatches before each public indexed socket path; preserve actual placement and error semantics.

source_trace.finding: Shell color/PBR inputs are tested for finiteness.
Finite large f32 input may overflow the powf(2.4) transfer result.
Writer sends derived linear color to material JSON.

findings.trigger_and_consequence: For sufficiently large finite input the computed material channel can become nonfinite. Historical 774 separately records exact then-inspected serde_json behavior mapping nonfinite to null; current native serde internals, actual GLB output, accepted color authoring range, and ordinary producer reachability were not assessed here.
findings.future_repair_direction: Select actual glTF material-factor and source HDR/color policies and reject nonfinite derived output at the appropriate native boundary without globally clipping valid HDR contexts.

nonfindings_and_limits.observation: Source checks nonempty geometry, finite positions/normals, in-range indices, and any complete triangle with area above threshold. At least one triangle can pass; this does not establish every triangle, remainder cardinality, winding, normal cardinality, clearance, visual quality, or whole catalog quality. Whether the intended diagnostic contract requires those properties remains open. No assertion of a defect merely because broader guarantees are absent.

Which finite color/HDR inputs are supported at the glTF material factor, and what current serializer and consumer policies apply?
What is the intended contract of diagnostic geometry checks versus full deformation and visual-quality acceptance?
What individual skin-weight/native-reduction semantics and UV-domain ownership are authoritative?
The 6533 bodies and exporter test tails are unread by this agent; other callers, native parsers, runtime, rendering and product outcomes remain outside this bounded assessment.

lenses.name: producer-propagation
lenses.bounded_assessment: 95e validate → compact → rigged → shell writer traces q460; armor direct UV and garment/socket producer traces are bounded. Other producers and native parsers remain open.

lenses.name: existing-type-owners
lenses.bounded_assessment: RiggedMesh, RiggedShell, typed joint/UV layout already express roles, but their public independent arrays do not alone establish correlated geometry; no blanket wrapper proposal.

lenses.name: admission-contracts
lenses.bounded_assessment: Public socket path can index before export validation; optional UV and finite input channels have qualified admissions, see historical socket and UV candidates. Actual all-producer guarantees remain open.

lenses.name: invariant-operations
lenses.bounded_assessment: Compaction requires synchronized vertex channels; finite input color transfer may overflow. Distinct original 774 candidate identities are preserved.

lenses.name: aggregate-states
lenses.bounded_assessment: Parallel geometry, skin, UV, index and morph populations require correlated extents/meaning. Shell/body and socket helpers rely on different admission points; do not assert a malformed ordinary generated asset.

lenses.name: type-ownership
lenses.bounded_assessment: Effective UV/compaction and public mesh/shell admission are candidate owners; canonical chart, material color and native format boundaries need wider producer support.

lenses.name: redundant-authority
lenses.bounded_assessment: Direct texcoords and surface UV can coexist; writer selects one by explicit precedence and compaction retains the other. Same q460 first failure; optional material modes may be intentional.

lenses.name: behavior-preservation
lenses.bounded_assessment: Three revision objects differ for every assigned role. Read current and cbbb production scope; 6533 bodies and test tails unread. No runtime, fixture, visual or behavioral equivalence assertion.

lenses.name: enum-shapes
lenses.bounded_assessment: Optional shell surface, direct UV, skin and texture states express separate supported modes. Their coupling requires contract evidence; no automatic flag-to-enum defect.

lenses.name: derivability
lenses.bounded_assessment: No independently substantiated derive substitution in displayed production scope; bespoke/native traits outside bounded sources are unassessed. No claim of lens-wide clearance.

lenses.name: type-granularity
lenses.bounded_assessment: Coordinate frames, UV chart identity, vertex indices and weights carry different semantics; skin and socket open contracts should be distinguished rather than merged by numeric representation.

lenses.name: magic-strings
lenses.bounded_assessment: glTF keys and diagnostic descriptions are native output boundaries; UV domain is compared for an actual input admission and needs catalog owner context before a closed-string claim. Probe diagnostic strings do not imply product execution.

lenses.name: magic-numbers
lenses.bounded_assessment: Color-transfer constants, thresholds, indices and linearly transformed coordinates have distinct units/policies. The nonfinite derived color is specific; no global clamping or prohibition of native protocol literals.

status: Bounded delegated source audit with exact unread ranges and unresolved producer/native policies; not whole-lens completion, product validation, implementation, or a checkpoint3821 reconstruction.
